source: CollegeFootballData API advanced season stats + games + FBS teams
rank_basis: Empirical percentile across all 138 FBS teams using CFBD 2026 season advanced stats; lower defensive EPA/Success Rate/Line Yards/explosiveness is better; higher defensive Havoc is better.
important: OSA values are schedule averages of opponent component ratings. No field adjustment multiplier is applied; the approved multiplier remains unvalidated.
